items.title: Beware of AI Content for SEO
items.zh_title: 警惕 AI 内容做 SEO 的风险
items.zh_oneliner: AI 内容用不好，反而会拖累搜索排名。
items.en_oneliner: AI content used poorly can drag search rankings down instead of lifting them.

items.title: Amazon SPN and The Client Acquisition Channel Agencies Are Sleeping On
items.zh_title: 亚马逊 SPN，代运营机构忽略的获客渠道
items.zh_oneliner: 亚马逊服务商网络能帮机构被卖家主动找到，是个低成本的获客入口。
items.en_oneliner: Amazon's Service Provider Network helps agencies get found by sellers, a low-cost acquisition channel.
